fluff.overview: Capellan infantry serve where BattleMechs and armor cannot be spared, which in the resource-constrained CCAF means nearly everywhere. The Xin Sheng movement revitalized the infantry arm alongside every other facet of the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces, giving foot soldiers better equipment and renewed purpose. Mechanized tracked platoons give Capellan commanders infantry that can keep pace with armored formations across rough terrain. The tracked transports provide better cross-country mobility than wheeled vehicles, allowing these platoons to operate alongside the tanks and combat vehicles that form the CCAF's armored reserve. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
